entries.name: Dragon (cute)
entries.style: low-poly chibi monster (Quaternius 2020), hand-painted texture flattened to flat colours; 0.8 m is a pet-sized pick for a stylized creature with no real-world size (wingspan 1.56 m)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Plan row 109 named Quaternius's Cute Monsters dragon on poly.pizza (behind a Cloudflare challenge). This is the same creature from the Aug 2020 textured release of the pack on OpenGameArt (CC0); the pipeline flattens its texture to flat colours. This release has Flying, Bite_Front, HitRecieve and Death (no separate Flying_Idle or Fast_Flying), so Flying serves as both idle and fly. Brows and wing membranes share one texel colour, so they share the wing role.
